features.name: Alchemical Device

sections.label: Special
sections.text: This ability can't be used by a [minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion).

features.target: Each enemy and object in the area

features.body: Each human acting this turn gains an edge on abilities until the end of their turn, or has a double edge on any ability that targets an enemy affected by a condition.
features.name: Exploit Opening

features.body: Each non-[minion](scc.v1:mcdm.monsters.v1/rule.organization/minion) human in the encounter regains [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) equal to 5 times their level.
features.name: Staying Power

flavor: At the start of any human's turn, you can spend Malice to activate one of the following features.
name: Human Malice
